verdict.rationale: Latham's IP Litigation page explicitly lists Trade Secrets Litigation as an area of focus. It says its team of more than 100 IP litigators handles trade secrets cases, and it quotes Chambers USA on its trade secret disputes. That satisfies the story's trade-secret-litigation option. Missing for 10: any documented confidentiality-program or employee-mobility work, specific trade-secret matters or outcomes, and independent corroboration beyond the firm's own page.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm documents trade-secret protection work — confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes, or trade-secret litigation
